info.headline: Minor Flood Warning for Thomson River and Thomson River at Camoola Park
info.description:
Minor flooding is likely along the Thomson River.
The Thomson River at Camoola Park is currently at 1.80 m and rising, below the minor flood level. The Thomson River at Camoola Park is likely to exceed the minor flood level (2.00 m) Thursday afternoon.
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

info.headline: Moderate Flood Warning for Barcoo River to Isisford, Barcoo River at Blackall and Barcoo River at Isisford Post Office
info.description:
Moderate flooding is occurring along the Barcoo River to Isisford.
The Barcoo River at Isisford Post Office is currently at 5.42 m and rising, with moderate flooding. The Barcoo River at Isisford Post Office is likely to peak above the moderate flood level (5.00 m) overnight Thursday into Friday. The river is expected to remain above the moderate flood level (5.00 m) into Friday.

info.headline: Moderate Flood Warning for Barcoo River downstream of Isisford and Barcoo River at Retreat
info.description:
Moderate flooding is likely along the Barcoo River downstream of Isisford.
The Barcoo River at Retreat is currently at 2.84 m and steady, above the minor flood level (2.14 m). The Barcoo River at Retreat is likely to exceed the moderate flood level (4.50 m) early next week. Further rises are possible as upstream flows arrive.
